title: Planning and rehosting: Discovery, Evaluator, MGN, Hub

kcs.statement: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) automates lift-and-shift (rehost) migration by continuously replicating source servers to AWS and launching them as EC2 instances at cutover.
AWS Application Discovery Service collects on-premises server configuration, utilisation and dependency data to plan a migration.
Migration Evaluator builds a data-driven business case by projecting what the current on-premises estate would cost to run on AWS.
AWS Migration Hub is a single place to discover, plan and track the progress of migrations across AWS and partner tools.

problem_ideas: A CFO asks 'what will our 400 servers cost on AWS?' before approving: which service builds the case?
Map which on-prem servers talk to each other before moving them: which service?
Rehost 60 VMware servers with minimal changes and a short cutover: which service?
A programme manager wants one view of progress across 12 migration waves: which service?
Order four services by migration phase: assess, plan, migrate, track.
Spot the distractor: 'MGN refactors applications into Lambda functions.'
